content.subject: Re: Price revision - Groomwell w.e.f. 1st Dec 2026
content.body:
Dear Neha,

Thank you for your note on the revised prices. We are pleased to accept the 4.0% revision from 1 December 2026 on all five lines: GW-01 at ₹197.60, GW-03 at ₹135.20, GW-04 at ₹109.20, GW-05 at ₹166.40 and GW-06 at ₹93.60.

We also note the extra 2% marketing support you offered with the full revision and will plan activity against it.

Please confirm the new rates in writing so that we can update our system.

Regards,
Category team
